items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I saw Mary Lou a couple of times...

ctx.x: How do you mean didn't charge him nothing?

I just liked him that much, he and his whole family. I just felt like I was in the family. The last time I played in his house Mary Lou Williams was out there. Boy, it was cold, not c-o-l-d but k-o-l-d. So after we finished working we went out... That was the last time I went out there. I saw Mary Lou a couple of times...
After you did the record in Atlanta and you came to New York and you went back down to Atlanta to work on a steady job. Where was the place you were working in Atlanta on a steady job?
